body: ac-00 (GATE, done): GO qualified. v19 confidence reliability on gold(n=805)+repr(n=259), --reframe. Confidence is MONOTONIC (cleanly on repr: 0.35->0.58->0.71->0.76->0.85 bottom-to-top bin) and separates right from wrong, but NOT calibrated (over-confident: 0.99 bin = 0.85 actual on repr). Abstention knee ~0.70: keeping >=0.70 lifts repr acc 0.714->0.798 and flags 51% of all wrong preds into the scrutinise bucket (0.531 acc). Rule/hint hardcoded confidences (0.85/0.9) pollute the curve (gold 0.70-0.85 dip; rule-set acc 0.865 at conf 0.770 vs pure-vote 0.826 at 0.874). Deliverable: output/calibrated-confidence/ac00_reliability_finding.md + calib_{gold,repr}.tsv + scripts/probe_confidence_calibration.py.

ac-01 (GATE, done): DESIGN = add quality_band (high>=0.85 / medium 0.70-0.85 / low<0.70) to profile output + runner-up on low band. Decided forks: (a) NO calibration map now (band reads ranking, robust to over-confidence; numeric map deferred); (b) NO unknown-conversion (destroys best guess + regresses headline) — flag+runner-up instead, per determinability-probe rec. Purely additive field, headline unchanged by construction. Open author decisions: default-on vs flag (rec default-on, B07-audited), thresholds 0.70/0.85 (rec as-is), runner-up on low only (rec yes). Deliverable: output/calibrated-confidence/ac01_policy_design.md. PAUSE for author approval of analyst-facing behaviour before ac-02 ships output-surface code.

ac-02 (done): shipped quality_band (high>=0.85/medium 0.70-0.85/low<0.70) + runner_up (low band, from vote_distribution 2nd-best) to profile json/csv/plain/markdown. Additive — label+confidence unchanged. Default-on (author-approved). B07 audit: codegraph ColProfile = profile.rs-local (3 syms), MCP/duckdb consume JSON output not struct, JsonSchema contract path left unchanged (follow-up). CI mirror green (fmt + clippy -D warnings + cargo test --workspace; cli_golden reads JSON by key, additive-safe). profile.rs.

ac-03 (GATE, done): GO. Band separation real+strong at top: high P=0.912 gold/0.816 repr (clearly above rest); repr fully monotonic 0.82->0.68->0.54 (low band = scrutinise signal, coin-flip). CAVEAT: medium(0.736) vs low(0.772) INVERT on gold but within overlapping CIs (n=87 vs 254) — medium is the muddy tier; load-bearing read is high-vs-not-high + the sharp low cut on production data. runner_up populates 63% gold/33% repr low-band, carries the TRUE answer in 12 gold/6 repr cases where top was wrong (minority bonus). NO regression (additive, label/confidence untouched). Not cosmetic; ship on as approved. Deliverable: output/calibrated-confidence/ac02_ac03_implementation_and_validation.md.
